name: git-guard
description: PreToolUse hooks that enforce git and GitHub CLI (gh) policy for coding agents — block pushes to main, deny hook bypass (--no-verify), ask before force-pushes, and auto-approve safe git and read-only gh commands plus gh pr create. The git policy runs on both claude-code and codex via hook-bridge (requires hook-bridge-runner on PATH); the gh policy is claude-code only.
